meta.title: Refer a friend | Puntr
meta.description: Invite friends to join Puntr and follow your referral activity from your member account.

referrals.title: Refer a friend
referrals.subtitle: Bring your sports community to Puntr.
referrals.heading: Share the game. Grow the community.
referrals.body: Invite friends to join Puntr, share sports conversations and build a public record of their picks. Referral tracking is tied to your member invite code.

invite.title: Invite your people
invite.body: Share your personal invite link by copying it or sending it on WhatsApp.

track.title: Track eligible referrals
track.body: See sign-ups and joined members from your account when referral data is available.

guest.title: Get your personal invite link
guest.body: Create a free Puntr account or sign in to access your referral link and activity.

meta.title: PuntPoints | Puntr
meta.description: Discover PuntPoints, Puntr's activity-based loyalty points and member rewards programme.

puntpoints.title: PuntPoints
puntpoints.subtitle: A little recognition for being part of the Puntr community.
puntpoints.heading: Points for participation. Never for outcomes.
puntpoints.body: PuntPoints are designed to recognise eligible community activity, such as confirming your email, sharing picks and inviting friends. They are not a stake, a betting balance or a reward for winning.

earn.title: Earn through activity
earn.body: Eligible actions can earn points under published programme rules.

explore.title: Explore member rewards
explore.body: Redeem points for available partner perks when the programme is enabled.

transparent.title: Keep it transparent
transparent.body: Points have no cash value and cannot be bought or exchanged for money.

puntpoints.fine: Availability, earning rules and rewards depend on programme status and eligibility. Points do not affect pick grading or leaderboard rankings.

meta.title: Live Scores | Puntr
meta.description: The Puntr live scores destination. Follow verified fixture and result updates as live score coverage is introduced.

liveScores.title: Live Scores
liveScores.subtitle: A dedicated matchday destination is being built for Puntr.
liveScores.heading: Live score coverage is coming
liveScores.body: This page is the home for future live match updates. Live scores are not currently available here, and we will not display sample scores as if they were happening now.

fixtures.title: Fixtures and results
fixtures.body: Check the Results area for available fixture and completed-result information.

data.title: Built around reliable data
data.body: Live status and score updates will only appear once a verified data source is connected and operational.

meta.title: Sports Tools | Puntr
meta.description: Explore upcoming Puntr tools: a free Betting Slip Converter, AI Edge Finder summary cards and Punt AI v1.0.

tools.lead: A growing toolkit for South African sports fans who want clearer context and better ways to understand the game. The features below are in development and are not yet available.

converter.name: Betting Slip Converter
converter.description: Convert supported bookmaker slip formats into a cleaner, easier-to-read format. Designed as a convenience tool, not a way to place bets.

edge.name: AI "Edge Finder" Summary Cards
edge.description: Concise, data-led match summary cards that surface relevant form, context and statistical signals. They are decision-support summaries, not guarantees or instructions to wager.

chat.name: Punt AI v1.0 Chatbot
chat.description: An AI sports assistant for exploring match context, asking questions about available data and understanding the numbers behind a fixture.

pro.title: Go deeper with Puntr Pro
pro.body: These optional tools are planned for Puntr Pro at R99 per month. Core community features remain free.

tools.fine: Tools provide information and context for general use. AI-generated content may be incomplete or inaccurate; check important details independently. Nothing on Puntr guarantees an outcome or constitutes financial advice. 18+ only. Gamble responsibly.

meta.title: Bookmakers | Puntr
meta.description: Explore bookmaker brands relevant to South African sports fans. Compare providers independently and check their terms before signing up.

bookmakers.title: Bookmakers
bookmakers.subtitle: A directory of betting brands South African sports fans may come across.

independent.title: Choose independently
independent.body: Puntr is an independent sports discussion and prediction-record platform. Listings are informational only; they are not endorsements, odds comparisons or recommendations to place a bet. Always check licensing, terms, age restrictions and safer-gambling tools directly with each provider.

bookmakers.fine: Puntr may receive compensation from some partners in future. Any paid relationship will be clearly disclosed. 18+ only. Gamble responsibly.

legal.translationNotice: This is a translation of the English page. If the two differ, the English version applies.
